summary: Compose a punctuation prefix form with user-defined infix operators under declared precedence and lexical core shadowing.

capabilities.requirement: Support the punctuation and operator experiments from the playground.
Resolve imported bindings headed by punctuation that TypeScript does not assign to expressions.
Let a prefix vector form consume one balanced bracket group.
Let pipeline and equality bindings consume left and right expressions.
Group the vector prefix before pipeline and group pipeline before equality.
Replace built-in equality only within an opted-in lexical scope.

syntaxNotes: The vector form uses a hash followed by a bracket group.
Pipeline passes its left operand as the first call argument.
Custom equality delegates to Object.is and declares core shadowing.

openDecisions.question: Allow hash-prefixed macro forms despite TypeScript private-name syntax?
